name: Hedda
title: Crown Surveyor
examine: Maps for the King, which no document will confirm. Her charts of the burn are the best since the old realm fell. She corrects distances mid-sentence, including yours.
lines: It is not a league to the crater. It is four thousand paces. Words matter.
I draw what is there. What it means is above my pay.
The Crown does not ask about Kingsdelf. It merely reads everything I send.
